critical_code_review_comments: regime_kombi._pivot_scan fix at lines 92-108 (j0 = min(ext_i+1, i)) correctly rebases the search window after the confirmed pivot bar; without it the crash-wick bar remained simultaneously ext_hi_i and ext_lo_i -> flip every `persist` bars. rca of the issue: Original bug: in _pivot_scan, after confirming a pivot the search window for the opposite extreme spanned [ext_i .. i] which INCLUDES the same crash-wick bar (10.10.2025 DOT/SUI -66% wick). That bar was simultaneously the ext_hi and the ext_lo, so every `persist` bars the detector flipped again on the same index -> endless pivots (up to 133 on the wick), delay 347 d, avg_delay 121 d for DOT/SUI. Fix: j0 = min(ext_i+1, i) rebases the opposite-extreme scan to start AFTER the confirmed pivot bar, so the wick can no longer be both ends. Verified independently on a synthetic -66% wick series: max_repeat_at_same_bar<=2, avg delay ~8 bars. Additionally scoring/grade now use macro-F1 + Cohen's kappa (regime_truth._f1_kappa) and RegimeQualityCard shows regime-quality-v1-warning for analyses computed under the old v1 reference.
